verdict: Complete SEC event populations, FINRA identity candidates and archived Nasdaq Trader directory states now provide substantially broader symbol, name and exchange-state evidence. No archive row is promoted to permanent security identity, and exchange-effective listing intervals remain unproven.
allowedInference: Positive symbol/name/source-exchange-code presence at a captured directory state and candidate dossier prioritization only.
forbiddenInference: No symbol row may establish permanent identity, CIK linkage, absence, listing continuity, first/final session or any return.
blockingReasons: Direct official CIK-ticker-exchange mapping snapshots begin in 2017, leaving no complete direct mapping history for 2009-2016.
Snapshot presence is not an effective-date interval and cannot establish continuous listing between observation times.
Form 8-A and EFFECT do not establish the first exchange-trading session.
Form 25/15 does not establish the final exchange-trading session, successor identity or delisting return.
Ticker reuse, share-class changes, reorganizations and exchange transfers require permanent security identity beyond issuer CIK.
No cost-free, lawful, survivorship-safe market panel has been proven to close these interval and terminal-return gaps.
A genuinely independent final-input audit has not occurred.
An exact ticker candidate is not a permanent security identifier and may fail across share-class, ticker or reorganization changes.
Retrospective name candidates are explicitly ineligible as point-in-time identity proof.
Sparse positive FINRA activity cannot prove absence or continuity between observed dates.
Archived symbol-directory rows have no stable security identifier or verified CIK linkage.
Sparse positive states cannot prove exchange-effective intervals or absence between captures.
Observed symbol/name variation requires explicit ticker-reuse, share-class and reorganization adjudication.
freeFallback: Use archived directory states to prioritize and cross-check source dossiers; require security-level primary evidence before identity or interval promotion and preserve unresolved transitions.
exitCriteria: Obtain a lawful security-level 2009-2024 listing history with stable identifiers and effective dates.
Independently reconcile ticker reuse, share classes, transfers, reorganizations, successors and terminal sessions.
Bind the exact final ledger to an authorized immutable checkpoint and pass external audit.
whatWouldChangeDecision: A lawful zero-cost security-level 2009-2024 master with stable identity, exchange-effective listing intervals, corporate actions, terminal sessions and delisting returns must pass independent audit.
